doorCode.description: The door the row applies to; null is the site default.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, an unknown field, an invalid path, query or header parameter, or a NUL byte in a body.

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

malformedBody.summary: Malformed JSON body or NUL byte

value.title: Malformed request body
value.detail: request body is not valid JSON for this operation

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is required
value.detail: send an Idempotency-Key header with a unique value per logical request

idempotencyKeyInvalid.summary: Idempotency-Key longer than 128 characters or not printable ASCII

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is invalid
value.detail: the Idempotency-Key header must be 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters

value.title: Limit is invalid
value.detail: limit must be an integer between 1 and 500

invalidCursor.summary: cursor is not a page token

value.title: Cursor is invalid
value.detail: cursor is not a valid page token

unknownQueryParameter.summary: A query parameter the collection does not declare

value.title: Query parameter is not supported
value.detail: query parameter is not supported: after

invalidQueryParameter.summary: A query parameter with a value that does not parse

value.title: Query parameter is invalid
value.detail: query parameter is invalid: state must be BOOKED, CHECKED_IN, COMPLETED, CANCELLED or NO_SHOW

invalidPathParameter.summary: A path parameter that is not an id of its kind

value.title: Path parameter is invalid
value.detail: path parameter is invalid: appointmentId: appointment id must be appt-<uuid>

invalidIfMatch.summary: An If-Match that is not an ETag of this service

value.title: If-Match header is invalid
value.detail: If-Match must be the ETag of the appointment

invalidAvailabilityQuery.summary: from and to are required, from < to, at most 14 days

value.title: Availability query is invalid
value.detail: availability range must be from < to, at most 14 days, minutes 1..240

422.description: The request is well formed JSON but a value-object or reference rule refuses it (invalid door code, carrier or window, window in the past, unknown door, door flow mismatch, unknown ASN, missing outbound reference, invalid operating hours or settings).

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

value.title: Door code is invalid
value.detail: door code must be 1..64 characters without whitespace, control characters or '/'

value.title: Carrier is invalid
value.detail: carrier must be 1..100 non-blank characters and the scac 2..4 upper-case letters

value.title: Window is invalid
value.detail: window must end after it starts and last at most the site maximum

value.title: Outbound appointment names no cutoff or shipment
value.detail: an OUTBOUND appointment needs a known cptId or at least one shipmentRef

value.title: Operating hours are invalid
value.detail: opensAt must be before closesAt for every row

value.title: Door is not a known dock slot
value.detail: door NOPE is not a known active dock slot

value.title: The door does not take this direction
value.detail: door WH1-DOCK-IN-01 takes Inbound only

value.title: An ASN is unknown or cancelled
value.detail: unknown or cancelled asn: ASN-9

value.title: Window starts in the past
value.detail: window must not start in the past

invalidReason.summary: ErrInvalidReason (REST accepts CARRIER_REQUEST and SITE_REQUEST only)

value.title: Cancellation reason is invalid
value.detail: cancellation reason must be CARRIER_REQUEST, SITE_REQUEST, ASN_CANCELLED or TURNED_AWAY

value.title: ETA is invalid
value.detail: eta must be set and its source at most 64 characters

value.title: Calendar settings are invalid
value.detail: calendar settings out of range

value.title: Closure is invalid
value.detail: closure needs an id, a door, a span ending after it starts and a reason
